displayName.zh: 罗弗敦群岛旅行准备度

title.zh: 交通信息与道路封闭状况

summary.en: Lofoten is exposed to the open ocean. Severe gales are common. The bridges connecting the islands (e.g., Gimsøystraumen) CLOSE automatically when wind speeds exceed safety limits.
summary.zh: 罗弗敦暴露在开阔的海洋中。强烈的大风很常见。当风速超过安全限制时，连接岛屿的桥梁（例如 Gimsøystraumen）会自动关闭。

mitigations.en: Check road status (175.no) constantly during bad weather.
mitigations.zh: 恶劣天气期间请不断查看路况（175.no）。

mitigations.en: Be prepared to be stuck on one island for a day.
mitigations.zh: 做好被困在某个岛上一天的准备。

summary.en: Famous summer hikes like 'Reinebringen' are EXTREMELY DANGEROUS in winter due to avalanche risk and ice on steep stairs. Fatalities have occurred.
summary.zh: 著名的夏季徒步路线如 'Reinebringen'（雷纳布林根）在冬季极度危险，存在雪崩风险且陡峭的阶梯结冰。曾发生过死亡事故。

mitigations.en: Do NOT hike Reinebringen in winter unless you are a professional climber with gear.
mitigations.zh: 除非你是装备齐全的专业登山者，否则冬季切勿攀登 Reinebringen。

mitigations.en: Stick to flat coastal walks or guided snowshoe tours.
mitigations.zh: 坚持走平坦的海岸步道或参加有向导的雪鞋行走团。

items.en: Ferry Booking (Bodø - Moskenes): Essential to book weeks/months ahead for vehicles.
items.zh: 渡轮预订（博德 - 莫斯克内斯）：车辆必须提前数周/数月预订。

items.en: Seasickness medication (The Bodø-Moskenes crossing is notorious for rough seas).
items.zh: 晕船药（博德-莫斯克内斯航线以风浪大而臭名昭著）。

items.en: Accommodation booking (Rorbuer often have minimum stay requirements).
items.zh: 住宿预订（渔屋 Rorbuer 通常有最低入住天数要求）。

items.en: Wide angle lens (for landscapes and Aurora)
items.zh: 广角镜头（用于风景和极光）

items.en: Microfiber cloths (lots of sea spray on lenses)
items.zh: 超细纤维擦镜布（镜头上会有很多海水飞沫）

items.en: Drone (check strict no-fly zones near Svolvær and Leknes airports)
items.zh: 无人机（检查斯沃尔韦尔和莱克内斯机场附近的严格禁飞区）

message.en: The E10 road is the main lifeline. It is narrow, winding, and shared with large fish trucks. In winter, it is icy/snowy. Pull over to let locals/trucks pass if you are driving slowly.
message.zh: E10 公路是主要生命线。它狭窄、蜿蜒，且有大型运鱼卡车通行。冬季路面有冰雪。如果您开得慢，请靠边停车让当地人/卡车先行。

title.en: Rent a car with studded tires (standard in winter)
title.zh: 租用带钉胎的汽车（冬季标准配置）

message.en: Jan-Apr is 'Skrei' season (Arctic Cod migration). Racks full of drying fish are everywhere (smell is strong). Restaurants serve fresh cod tongues and liver - local delicacies.
message.zh: 1月至4月是 'Skrei' 季节（北极鳕鱼洄游）。到处都是挂满干鱼的架子（气味很重）。餐厅供应新鲜的鳕鱼舌和肝——这是当地的美味佳肴。

askUser.en: Are you interested in booking a fishing boat trip?
askUser.zh: 您有兴趣预订出海钓鱼行程吗？
